collection.name: Suwappu Positions
collection._supply_comment: 4,444 — retuned 2026-08-26 from 10,000 against real Robinhood Chain data (docs/research/robinhood-chain-nft-*.md). The chain's strongest collection (StonkBrokers, sold out, ~$22.5K floor, $4.7M volume) is 4,444; the floor-durability band observed on chain 4663 is 4,000-6,000. 7.7k-10k supplies build breadth only with free mints and hold no floor.
collection.tagline: Pick one of the 35 tokenized equities with a live Chainlink feed on Robinhood Chain. Your entry price is stamped on-chain forever.
collection.compliance: Collectible position card. It records a price observed on a DEX at mint time and displays a notional return against it. It is NOT equity, NOT a security, NOT a derivative or a claim of any kind, confers no shareholder or voting rights, pays nothing out, and gives no economic exposure to any issuer or to the referenced ERC-20.

economics._comment: Fee discount for holding any Position, PROPORTIONAL to whatever rate the holder is already on — not a flat number of bps off the swap. 0.40 = 40% off your rate. A flat bps subtraction was tried first and collapsed the tier ladder: 40 bps off unevenly-spaced tiers (FREE 100 / PRO 50 / PREMIUM 30 / ENTERPRISE 10) floored PRO and PREMIUM to the same rate as ENTERPRISE, so a card made a $29.99 plan worth exactly what a $9.99 one was. Proportional keeps them apart: FREE 100->60, PRO 50->30, PREMIUM 30->18. NOT OFFERED ON ENTERPRISE — that tier is contracted pricing, negotiated per customer, and a card anyone can buy on the secondary market must not move a rate that was agreed in a contract. Self-serve tiers are additionally floored at the ENTERPRISE rate, so a perk can match contracted pricing but never beat it. On FREE this is unchanged from the original flat-40-bps design: $4 saved per $1,000 swapped, so an active trader recoups a mint in ~$4k of volume. REVENUE TRADEOFF: deliberately material — a 5% token is not worth minting. Mirrored on-chain by holdDiscountFractionBps (basis points OF THE TIER RATE, 4000 = 40%) and clamped by MAX_CARD_DISCOUNT_FRACTION in bot/services/position_cards_service.py; tests/test_position_cards.py pins all three together, and tests/test_fee_service.py pins the ENTERPRISE exclusion.
economics._gold_comment: Founders' Gold tier perk: 55% off the tier rate (under the on-chain MAX_HOLD_DISCOUNT_FRACTION_BPS = 6000 ceiling and the bot's MAX_CARD_DISCOUNT_FRACTION clamp). Gold is stamped per token at mint (Phase.Gold), never rolled — the StonkBrokers/Gremlin lesson: real utility inside the token is what held the only durable floors on chain 4663. A holder's discount is the best single card they hold: gold 55%, else 40%. Per holder, not per card — stacking cannot compound it.
economics._max_discount_fraction_comment: Mirrors MAX_HOLD_DISCOUNT_FRACTION_BPS (on-chain, 6000 == 0.60) and MAX_CARD_DISCOUNT_FRACTION (bot/services/position_cards_service.py, 0.60) — the hard ceiling any discount (base or Gold) can ever be tuned to, not the current Gold rate. Pinned three-way in tests/test_position_cards.py.
economics._royalty_comment: ERC-2981 default royalty in bps. 2% is the only royalty verified on-chain in the Robinhood Chain market research (Robinhood Punks); the chain norm is 2-5%, and undercutting to the verified floor keeps secondary friction lowest.
economics._badge_comment: Rank badges rescaled to 4,444 supply at the original proportions (5% / 20%). Badges are earned by mint rank; the Gold EDITION is a separate, purchased, per-token stamp — the two never collide.

_sector_colors_comment: Muted jewel tones, not pastels. Each is anodised into the matte charcoal ground at 6% and lightened for type, so it must read as a tinted metal — steel, bronze, gunmetal — never as candy. Retuned for the luxury plate (Centurion / Robinhood Gold lineage).
_ticker_caps_comment: Rescaled from the 10,000-card caps to sum exactly 4,444 (largest-remainder, floor 10 for the thinnest names) — relative depth weights preserved.

mint._comment: Phase plan, retuned 2026-08-26 against real Robinhood Chain sale data (docs/research/robinhood-chain-nft-market-research.md). Allocations sum to MAX_SUPPLY minus the 45-card team reserve; a phase cannot oversell, so latecomers get a clean revert instead of a gas war. Structure mirrors the only pattern on chain 4663 that produced BOTH a fast sellout and real revenue — Spritehood's two-tier: a cheap broad tier plus a premium tier at ~12% of units carrying ~50% of revenue ($17/$117 there; $19/$119 here). At sellout: 3,400 x $19 = $64.6k standard + 555 x $119 = $66.0k Gold — Gold is 50.5% of revenue on 12.5% of supply. The free Founder claim shrinks from 1,500 (34% of the old collection — a giveaway that scale of free kills the floor) to 444 earned claims: on 4663, free/burn-gated tiers reliably drive sellouts but hold no price, so free is a gate, not the majority. Recommended sale order: Founder claim -> Gold + Allowlist -> Public (timing is set at configurePhase time; the index is the contract enum value, not the order).

Founder.who: Earned: XP level gold/platinum, >= $50k lifetime volume, or >= 5 referrals
Founder.note: Free claim. These are the users who already built the product's volume. Cap 1: 444 distinct earned holders, matching the 0.8-0.9+ holder/supply ratios every healthy 4663 collection shows.

Allowlist.who: Earned: >= 5 swaps, >= $1k lifetime volume, or >= 1 referral

Gold.note: The premium tier: stamped Gold on-chain per token at mint, struck in gold on the plate, and carrying the 55% fee discount. Priced at $119 against Spritehood's verified $117 premium.

mint._price_comment: USD CENTS, not ETH. SuwappuPositions prices in cents (uint96) and converts to wei at mint time through the ETH/USD Chainlink feed, so a card costs the same $20 whether ETH is at $2k or $4k. The previous price_eth fields were the wrong unit: fed to configurePhase() they would truncate to 0 cents, and 0 now reverts with PriceZero. A deliberately free phase (Founder) goes through configureFreePhase() instead.

brand._comment: Lifted from packages/design-tokens/src/tokens.ts -> designTokens.brand, which is now the single canonical source for every Suwappu surface (previously this read showcase/tailwind.config.ts, one of two live and disagreeing systems). tests/test_brand_tokens.py re-reads the package and fails if these drift.
